title: MV/MZ APK Converter – Build Android APKs from RPG Maker Games Easily

posts.author: TenDev
posts.body:
Download Now
​
Want to turn your RPG Maker MV or MZ game into a working Android APK
without messing with complex setup steps
?
APK Converter
is a lightweight, beginner-friendly tool that helps you convert your exported RPG Maker games (via Cordova) into Android APK files —
fast and easy
.
What It Does​
Instantly converts your RPG Maker MV/MZ project into an APK
Includes a clear, step-by-step setup guide
Lets you build your first APK in just a few minutes
Perfect for RPG Maker developers who just want to
get their game running on Android
without wasting hours configuring tools.
Requirements​
You’ll need these installed first:
PC/Laptop
RPG Maker MV or MZ
A simple setup guide is included to walk you through everything.
Limitations​
Doesn’t auto-sign APKs — you’ll still need to sign manually or use Android Studio
Not a “1-click” builder — but it
removes 90% of the hassle
Built for developers who can already export their game and want a
faster, smoother build process
.
Terms of Use​
Free for both personal and commercial projects
You can modify it for personal use
Do not resell or redistribute the tool as your own
Download Now

posts.author: DrFreeman
posts.body: Incredible work. It makes creating debug versions so easy. I could throw a new version in in less than 5 minutes after sending bug fixes to QA.

posts.author: Krosis
posts.body: Thank you for the instructions. I had 0 knowledge and it took me around 2 hours to set it up, but now that it's working it takes around 5-6 min to convert a game from deployment to the final .APK file. Granted I only tried the debug version, but I do not plan to publish on Google Play so it doesn't matter.
